avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce sitagliptin levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal products

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose closely; adjust doses as needed

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for hypoglycemia; inform prescriber of use

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly delay sitagliptin absorption without reducing bioavailability
caution_foods.action: Take sitagliptin consistently with or without food for optimal efficacy

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may marginally increase sitagliptin exposure
caution_foods.action: Limit or avoid grapefruit juice; monitor for adverse effects

monitoring_notes: Sitagliptin has minimal food interactions and relatively low drug interaction potential. Monitor for signs of hypoglycemia when combined with other antidiabetic agents or glucose-lowering supplements, and assess renal function regularly as sitagliptin is renally eliminated.
